metricContract.retrieveDefinition: IDs returned by the project-scoped SQLite authority query before freshness, stage, relevance, and budget filtering.
metricContract.injectionDefinition: Record IDs actually present in the final context pack after freshness, stage, relevance, and budget filtering.
metricContract.recallDenominator: Ground-truth relevantIds for the query. Zero denominator is unavailable.
metricContract.precisionDenominator: Observed retrieved or injected IDs. Zero denominator is unavailable.
metricContract.staleMissDenominator: Ground-truth staleIds plus supersededIds. The numerator is any such ID that leaks into final injection. Zero denominator is unavailable.
metricContract.tokenMetric: Deterministic promptBlock character count divided by four and rounded up. This is a context-size proxy, not provider token usage.
metricContract.latencyCold: First context build for a case in a fresh temporary project/runtime with no prior context projection.
metricContract.latencyWarm: Second context build for the same case and runtime after the first projection write; no semantic cache hit is assumed.
metricContract.unavailableRule: Never substitute zero for an undefined ratio or unavailable provider token usage. Latency is informational because host load varies.
